title: fix(rest): the app metadata bundle serves its objects in the object list's order
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ88ufNEZsxoeAzp4WfYk5fTh)_

Fixes #29680

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Claim: 6593195648 (seat `domain:server#1`). Triage designation 6593258467: one cross-domain PR in `domain:server` covering the rest fix and the two `app-bundle.zod.ts` order sentences. **This unblocks #29552 leg 1**, whose PR waits on this one (`Blocked-by`).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:应用元数据包(`GET /meta/app/{appId}/bundle`)里的 `objects` 改按对象列表的顺序返回,不再是"导航先、反向关联后"。集合不变,只是顺序。spec 里该响应的文档注释和 `objects` 描述同步改成对象列表顺序,参考页按生成器重新生成。
- 为什么改:#29552 第一步让控制台的记录页从包里取对象范围。记录页的相关列表按拿到的对象顺序排,一个导航对象又引用另一个导航对象时(联系人→客户),页签顺序和从对象列表取时不同。
- 风险与回滚:导航顺序与对象列表顺序不一致的应用,包里 `objects` 的顺序会变;今天没有读者依赖这个顺序(界面按名字建索引)。导航顺序本就与列表一致的包逐字节不变。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`packages/rest/src/meta-app-bundle-routes.ts` 的 `inObjectListOrder` 和调用处;`packages/spec/src/api/app-bundle.zod.ts` 的两句契约文字;`meta-app-bundle-routes.test.ts` 新增的 #29680 用例。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/meta-app-bundle-routes.test.ts`,预期 1 个文件、19 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(spec 路径,先过契约复审)。

## What changes

- **`packages/rest/src/meta-app-bundle-routes.ts`.** The bundle built its objects as `members('object', [...reach.objects, ...inbound])`. `inboundRelationObjects` skips the reach targets, so an inbound object that is also a navigation object (`contact` referencing `account`) kept its navigation place. The route now serves the same names through a new exported `inObjectListOrder(list, names)`: every name the object list holds, at its first position in that list (the list `objectList()` already reads), then the names the list does not hold, in their own (navigation) order. The set is unchanged, so views and pages, which derive from the served set, do not move. Nothing else in the bundle changes.
- **`packages/rest/src/rest-route-ledger.ts`.** The route's ledger note now reads "objects: navigation plus one hop of inbound relationships, in object-list order".
- **`packages/spec/src/api/app-bundle.zod.ts`.** Docs only, no key and no shape change. The docblock's `objects` bullet said "in navigation order; then ... in registry order"; it now says the navigation objects and their inbound relations come "all in the object list's order; a name the object list does not hold follows the listed ones, in navigation order". The `objects` `.describe()` says "in the object list's order". `content/docs/references/api/app-bundle.mdx` was regenerated with `gen:schema` + `gen:docs`; no other tracked artefact moved.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/29680-app-bundle-object-list-order.md`: `@objectstack/rest` patch, `@objectstack/spec` patch (the docblock ships in `dist`).

**Readers of the bundle's `objects` array** (checked before editing): `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/app-bundle.ts` `indexAppBundle` indexes every member by type and name into a `Map`; `packages/client` `meta.getAppBundle` passes the body through. No reader relies on reach-first order. Navigation reads the app's own entries, not this array.

## Tests

`packages/rest/src/meta-app-bundle-routes.test.ts`:

- The three reach-first pins on the shared CRM fixture (admin bundle, undetermined-visibility bundle, `enableCache: false` bundle) now expect `account, contact, secret_deal, note, task, deal_line`. That fixture is the card's case: `contact` is a navigation object that references `account`.
- `inObjectListOrder` unit case, including names the list does not hold (kept after, in their own order).
- An app whose navigation names `contact` then `account` (one references the other): objects come back `account, contact, note, task`; views and pages are the same set as before.
- CONTROL: an app whose navigation already follows the list (`account` only): the served `objects` are byte-equal to the reach-first derivation's item reads (`account, contact, note`).

<details><summary>Ablation: reach-first again, once, restored</summary>

Through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (wrap mode, restore trap) under `os-verify-lock`, on commit 8c59a533. The test imports the route from `src` (relative import), so no build leg applies.

```
ablation-replace: anchor   "members('object', inObjectListOrder(listed, [...reach.objects, ...inbound]))"  x1 (before)
ablation-replace: replace  "members('object', [...reach.objects, ...inbound])"  x0 -> x1
ablation-replace: ok mutation landed: anchor 1 -> 0, blob 76947cadad64 -> ca6f86bfc9db
     × admin: every reached member, objects in the object list's order (#29680), the body parsing against the declared shape
     × two navigation objects where one references the other come back in object-list order
     × a member served under an undetermined field visibility serves the bundle no-store with no validator
     × `metadata.enableCache: false` sends no validator and answers a matching If-None-Match in full, as the item reads do
AssertionError: expected [ 'account', 'secret_deal', …(4) ] to deeply equal [ 'account', 'contact', …(4) ]
      Tests  4 failed | 15 passed (19)
ablation-replace: ok restored: blob == HEAD (76947cadad64) and `git diff HEAD` is empty
```

The CONTROL stayed green under the mutation: reach-first and list order agree on it.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The order sentence in the spec contract is the only contract text that pinned reach-first; it changed in this PR with triage's designation, so the server and its declared contract agree.
- `check:dev-prereqs` (local-only) exits 1 on this container because 35 workspace packages (mostly `ui/**`) are not built; `packages/spec/dist` was rebuilt from this head before the gates.
